title: Implementation Guide: The Post-Go-Live Stabilization Period for Service Level Credits
content:
The months just after go-live of a Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement are a stabilization period with reduced service level credits for the latest census month:

- where fewer than 6 whole months have passed from the go-live date to the first day of the claimed month, a month counting as whole only once the day of the month of the go-live date is reached, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day, the credit percentage is multiplied by 0.75;
- where at least 6 but fewer than 12 such months have passed, by 0.9;
- otherwise it is not multiplied.

The go-live date is the one on the agreement record.

## Examples (hypothetical)

| Go-live date | First day of the claimed month | Whole months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 1st of a month | 4 months later | 4 | 0.75 |
| the 10th of a month | the 1st, 6 calendar months later | 5 | 0.75 |
| the 1st of a month | 6 months later | 6 | 0.9 |
| the 1st of a month | 12 months later | 12 | none |
